title: The Tell-Tale Heart: English short story with meanings
description: Read The Tell-Tale Heart by Edgar Allan Poe in English: the full text with simple meanings for old words. Level B2, about 14 minutes.
intro: A man insists he is not mad while he tells how an old man's pale eye drove him to murder. Poe's short, breathless sentences make it readable at B2, and the old literary words are explained in simple English.
